issue.title: test_kind_mismatch_when_default_disagrees_with_kind: demo_flag() test helper doesn't accept 'default' kwarg
issue.description: just test-scoped fails: tests/feature_flags/test_integrity.py::test_kind_mismatch_when_default_disagrees_with_kind raises TypeError: demo_flag() got an unexpected keyword argument 'default'. The test calls demo_flag('demo_flag', kind='beta', default=True) but the demo_flag() test helper's signature does not have a default parameter -- looks like the helper's signature and this call site drifted apart. Confirmed pre-existing on master (d6f88f7b9) via git stash + direct pytest invocation, unrelated to any in-flight change.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: TypeError from a keyword-argument signature mismatch is deterministic, not timing/environment sensitive; reproduced twice (once under just test-scoped's parallel run, once via direct isolated pytest invocation) with the identical traceback.

payload.entry: Verified on clean master b7bdd3185 that the reported pytest node no longer exists. Commit 2b2c5edef removed test_kind_mismatch_when_default_disagrees_with_kind as part of the breaking flag-bead redesign, and FeatureFlagDefinition no longer has the obsolete default field that caused the demo_flag helper mismatch. This is not a skipped failing test: the contract under test was intentionally removed, so adding a default parameter to the helper would resurrect dead behavior.

payload.close_reason: Superseded by the flag-task redesign in 2b2c5edef, which removed both the stale test and the obsolete default-field contract.
